Calendar

Each homework goes out on Monday and is due the following Sunday at 11:00pm. The Monday cell carries the handout; the deadline is repeated in that week's Friday cell.

Each mastery quiz can be attempted up to three times, on the Monday and Wednesday of the week it is introduced and again the following Monday. A few quizzes get two attempts instead of three, because a scheduled attempt falls on a holiday, the midterm, or finals week. Every cell says which attempt it is and flags the last chance.

  • Lecture
  • Mastery quiz
  • Mock interview
  • Homework due
  • Exam
  • Deadline
